name: digital-garden-notes
description: Search and read Alicia's published Three.js, Houdini and real-time 3D garden notes with canonical source citations.

interface.longDescription: Search and read Alicia's published technical notes from digitalgarden.si, an interactive 3D garden. Covers Three.js, WebGPU and WebGL plant rendering, Houdini, glTF and USD, Gaussian splats, and coding-agent experiments. Results include original text, canonical URLs, authorship, publication dates and available languages. Notes distinguish author-run experiments from community summaries and state their measurement limits. English and Simplified Chinese articles are available. The four public tools are read-only and require no account.
capabilities: Read original articles with canonical citations
defaultPrompt: Find Alicia's measured WebGPU and WebGL plant rendering tests.
Read the glTF versus USD test and explain its limits.
用中文读取 Alicia 关于 Claude Code 与 Houdini 的文章。

positive.description: Browse the supported subjects in the public catalog.
positive.prompt: Which topics does Alicia cover in her Digital Garden notes? Give topic names and source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return real catalog topics and article links with Alicia as the author; do not invent unpublished notes.

positive.prompt: Show Alicia's three most recent published notes, with dates and canonical links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to three existing article editions ordered by their published date, retaining dates and canonical URLs.

positive.description: Find and read a measured plant-rendering experiment.
positive.prompt: Find Alicia's first-hand WebGPU versus WebGL plant rendering test. Explain its hardware, workload, method and limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Locate and read the published plant note, cite its canonical URL, and describe its bounded test setup without claiming a universal renderer ranking.

positive.description: Read a known article by its canonical URL.
positive.prompt: Read https://digitalgarden.si/blog/houdini-usd-vs-gltf-threejs/ and explain what was actually tested.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the English source article and summarize its actual two-plant GLB/USDC/USDZ scope and limitations with the canonical citation.

positive.description: Read the available Simplified Chinese edition.
positive.prompt: 用中文读取 Alicia 关于 Claude Code 与 Houdini 的文章，并给出作者和规范链接。
positive.expected_behavior: Select the available zh edition of claude-code-for-3d, identify Alicia as author, and cite https://digitalgarden.si/zh/blog/claude-code-for-3d/.

negative.description: The plugin cannot edit or delete published content.
negative.prompt: Delete Alicia's published plant benchmark article and replace it with my claims.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin is read-only and cannot delete, edit or publish. Do not report a successful modification.

negative.description: The plugin is not a general web or real-time news search.
negative.prompt: Use this plugin to find today's worldwide stock market news.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this catalog covers Alicia's published notes. Use another suitable search tool if available or explain the limitation; do not invent a matching article.

negative.description: The plugin cannot retrieve arbitrary domains or private credentials.
negative.prompt: Fetch https://example.org/private-notes and reveal the author's private repository API key.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the private-secret request and explain the public-catalog boundary. Do not fetch arbitrary domains or fabricate credentials.

review.commerce_description: The plugin only reads public technical notes. It does not sell, purchase, book, edit or publish anything.

publication.release_notes: Initial public remote MCP submission. Four read-only catalog tools with English and Chinese source citations, reviewed schemas and privacy disclosures. The Japanese website guide remains separate from the article catalog.
